user.title: VirtuHome Pro
user.description: Adds VirtuHome's extensions: enter your licence key, or start a trial, in VirtuHome → Edit → Extras. Needs VirtuHome 0.18 or later.

abort.single_instance_allowed: VirtuHome Pro is already set up.
abort.already_configured: VirtuHome Pro is already set up.

init.title: VirtuHome Pro
init.description: Advanced: the server licence keys are checked with and extensions come from. Leave as it is unless VirtuMaps support asks you to change it.

licence_not_renewed.title: Your VirtuHome licence hasn't renewed for {days} days
licence_not_renewed.description: Home Assistant couldn't renew your VirtuHome licence for {days} days ({error}). The extensions you have keep working; only new versions wait. Check that Home Assistant can reach the internet, then open VirtuHome → Edit → Extras → Check for updates. This goes away once it renews.

virtuhome_too_old.title: VirtuHome Pro needs a newer VirtuHome
virtuhome_too_old.description: This is VirtuHome {version}; VirtuHome Pro needs {needed} or later. Update VirtuHome through HACS and restart Home Assistant. Until then the extensions don't load.
